text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In that moment, on that day, she<n>shined
brighter—and more<n>brilliantly—than anyone else. That
was<n>the first time we ever met.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I met her at a scrimmage. During the<n>final
stretch—out of nowhere—she<n>overtook one, then
another, and yet<n>another...

text_block_list.name: Racers
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Huh?! No way she's that<n>fast!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She swept aside the competition and<n>flew into first!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That explosive, overwhelming power.<n>That brilliant,
yet beautiful running. It<n>was just like...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew! Hehe, that feltpretty good.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho! Come over here! It's<n>time to review
and reflect on the race<n>you ran just now.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Your victory is commendable, but be<n>careful not to
rely on a last-minute<n>burst of speed. If you can
clean up<n>your running during the rest of the<n>race—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Shuuut up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Shaddup, shaddup, shaddup! Don't<n>tell me what to
do! 'Cause I'm not<n>gonna listen to a siiingle word
you<n>say!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Sw-Sweep?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nope, nuh-uh, nada—I'm not<n>listeniiing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, what's her deal?! This<n>sucks! It's all
so boring—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, you! What're you looking<n>at?!
choice_data_list: Um... it was, uh, like magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm so lost in thought about her<n>running that I end
up saying the first<n>thing that comes to mind. She's
probably weirded out by what I just—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Did you just say magic?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You said it, didn't you?! M-a-g-i-c!<n>Just now!
Explain yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmm! ♪ So sweet! ♪ Deeelish! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
An hour—and one chocolate parfait<n>with extra
whipped cream—later,<n>Sweep Tosho smiles with a
look of<n>satisfaction on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: As for how this happened, well...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if we're gonna talk, let's talk over<n>sweets!
Lemme eat something. Your<n>treat, of course!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Can't you see how tired I am from all<n>that
running?! Some pudding, a<n>parfait, or even a
cake—just gimme<n>some sweets, nooow!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, I won't settle foranything average! It's gotta besweet, yummy, AND cute! ♪ So, leadthe way! C'mooon!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so, after a bit of coercion, I find<n>myself here.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, about what we were talking<n>about earlier. You
said my running<n>was like magic, didn't you?
What'd<n>you mean by that?
choice_data_list: Uhhh, it just kinda popped into my head, honest—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's it?! What the heck, I don't get<n>you at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hah... whatever. And here I was,<n>thinking I'd finally
found a lead on<n>racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yup... Grandma taught it to me. She<n>told me racing
magic was the best.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It looks like you don't know, so I'll fill<n>you in.
You're in the presence of the<n>genius Magical Girl
Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'll become a great witch<n>like Grandma.
That's why I need to<n>hurry up and learn racing
magic.
choice_data_list: ...So you want to learn how to use magic?
...So you want to learn how to use magic?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Who wouldn't?! Listen up, okay?<n>Magic is...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna! No, no, no! Nooooo<n>waaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sw-Sweepy! There's nothing to be<n>scared of,
okay? You're great at<n>English! Your teacher even
told me<n>you got a perfect score on your last t—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna! If I don't wanna, I<n>don't wanna!
I'm not going!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Father
text_block_list.text:
Um, how about singing then? We can<n>go to singing
lessons instead! You<n>won an award for that too!
I'm sure<n>this is the st—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nooo meanssss nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(No, no, no! I mean, it's all so boring!<n>Do this, do
that—everyone's always<n>trying to tell me what to
do!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Getting praised for doing well<n>doesn't make it fun!
So I'm done!<n>Never again! No, no, no!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! My child, you're too<n>young to be bored
by the world<n>already. Let's see here...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Carpe diem!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Now, isn't that a nice fragrance?<n>Take a deep
breath and take it all in,<n>my little Sweepy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
These flowers are so pretty... But<n>how?! You didn't
have these a<n>second ago! How... C'mon, c'mon,
c'mon—how'd you do it?! Tell me<n>already,
Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
You want to know? Sweepy, this<n>here, is magic. I'm
a great witch, so I<n>can use every kind of magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Magic?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Magic, huh? Tell me more, tell me<n>more! It sounds
really fun!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I wanna try too! I wanna try using<n>magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I can see that. Then come with<n>me. I've got
the perfect hat for you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
My little Sweepy. Listen well, because<n>Grandma is
about to teach you just<n>how fun and exciting magic
can be!
